gaps.lead: The bad weather meant we couldn't leave the house.
He didn't study, so he failed the exam.
gaps.sentence: If he had studied, he ___ the exam.
gaps.explanation: If + past perfect, would have + past participle.

gaps.lead: My advice is to check the contract twice before signing.
gaps.sentence: You ___ the contract twice before signing.
gaps.explanation: had better + infinitive without 'to' = strong advice.

gaps.lead: She'll be on a flight, so she can't join the call.
gaps.sentence: She'll be on a flight, so ___ join the call.
gaps.explanation: won't be able to = future inability.

gaps.answer: No sooner had he been elected
gaps.lead: He was elected, and he broke his first promise immediately.
gaps.sentence: ___ than he broke his first promise.
gaps.explanation: Passive inversion: No sooner had he been elected than…

gaps.lead: 'I have never lied to the press,' the minister said.
gaps.explanation: deny + -ing (ever strengthens the denial): denied ever lying.
